# From Behind the Curtain

Here - behind the curtain,  
through bars and glass,  
I see the garden,  
with butterflies fluttering over beds of freshly cut grass.

Here - behind the curtain,  
the ego creeps away with me,  
as if to vanish into the void,  
yet it stands firm, as if to fight its false existence.

Here - behind the curtain,  
together on the windowsill,  
dead flies and a bumblebee,  
sun-dried and still like echoes that once rang in my mind.

Here - behind the curtain,  
through bars and glass,  
the blue sky calls in bright sunshine:  
come out, come play among butterflies and blooms on freshly cut grass.

One, two, three,  
here I come, ready or not,  
the hide-and-seek is over and done -  
block the ego, the garden beckons me.
